concept.title: Configure identity provider (IdP) integration for your organization
concept.shortdesc: Identity provider integration is a component of the Identity and Access Management services provided by Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console.

conbody.p: Identity Provider Integration establishes your corporate single sign-on (SSO) solution as a valid identity provider for the Red Hat single sign-on system. IdP integration supports Open ID Connect (OIDC) and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) authentication.

note.p: When you modify your identity provider integration, users in your organization must re-link their user accounts in the following situations:

ul.li: You delete an existing identity provider and configure a new one.

The identifier for your identity provider changes, for instance, if your company changes SSO or IdP vendors.
For SAML configurations, the identifier is the nameid attribute.
For OIDC configurations, the identifier is the sub claim.
A user leaves and returns to your organization. The user can replace a preexisting link with a new link when the One-time account linking required login message is displayed.
